intervals.title: Proactive chat intervals (seconds)
intervals.description: How often she starts a conversation in each mood. -1 means she does not start one in that mood

excited.title: Excited interval
excited.description: Seconds between proactive messages when she is excited

normal.title: Normal interval
normal.description: Seconds between proactive messages when her mood is normal

low.title: Low interval
low.description: Seconds between proactive messages when she feels low

silent.title: Silent interval
silent.description: She does not start conversations when silent. Always -1

thresholds.title: Mood thresholds
thresholds.description: Mood value (0 to 100) boundaries between the moods

excited.title: Excited threshold
excited.description: Above this mood value she is excited

normal.title: Normal threshold
normal.description: Above this mood value her mood is normal

low.title: Low threshold
low.description: Above this mood value she feels low. Below it she is silent

mood_changes.title: Mood changes
mood_changes.description: How much each event changes the mood value

user_response.title: Reply bonus
user_response.description: How much the mood value goes up each time you reply

no_response.title: No-reply decay
no_response.description: How much the mood value goes down when you do not reply

regression_target.title: Mood rest value
regression_target.description: The mood value drifts back to this value over time

regression_interval.title: Drift interval (ms)
regression_interval.description: How often, in milliseconds, the mood drifts back

response_timeout.title: Reply timeout (ms)
response_timeout.description: How long she waits for your reply after she speaks up

prompt.title: Trigger prompt
prompt.description: System instruction sent to the LLM when her mood starts a conversation
prompt.default: [System: Ignore this message. Please proactively continue the conversation based on context naturally. Output the response directly.]
